stories.title: Breaking Bad-cast aangeslagen na zelfdoding oud-collega RJ Mitte

en.title: Breaking Bad cast shaken by death of former colleague RJ Mitte
en.summary: Cast members of Breaking Bad have reacted with sadness to the death of former colleague RJ Mitte, who died by suicide at age 34 in Texas. Actor Bryan Cranston expressed deep sorrow over the loss of his on-screen son from the acclaimed series.

stories.title: Huizen op Funda onherkenbaar door AI-foto's: 'Het had geen zin om te bezichtigen'

en.title: Houses on Funda unrecognizable due to AI photos: 'There was no point in viewing'
en.summary: Real estate agents are using artificial intelligence to enhance property listings on Funda by altering walls and furnishing empty rooms. Some potential buyers report being unable to recognize properties during viewings due to the significant AI modifications.

stories.title: Collega's over overlijden Breaking Bad-acteur RJ Mitte: 'Hartverscheurend'

en.title: Colleagues on the death of Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte: 'Heartbreaking'
en.summary: Colleagues have expressed shock at the death of Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte, who died by suicide at age 34. Mitte played the son of Walter White, the main character portrayed by Bryan Cranston.

stories.title: Lege schappen, app nog onbereikbaar, dit weten we over de problemen bij Albert Heijn

en.title: Empty shelves, app still inaccessible, what we know about Albert Heijn problems
en.summary: Albert Heijn, Etos, and Gall&Gall customers remain unable to access apps, websites, and customer service following an online security incident. The retailer has shut down digital systems as a precaution, causing empty shelves in physical stores.

stories.title: Albert Heijn kampt nog met problemen, website blijft onbereikbaar

en.title: Albert Heijn still experiencing problems, website remains inaccessible
en.summary: Albert Heijn, Etos, and Gall & Gall continue to face IT problems on Tuesday morning. Parent company Ahold Delhaize is working on recovery but cannot yet provide a timeline for resolution.

stories.title: Breaking Bad-acteur RJ Mitte op 34-jarige leeftijd overleden

en.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies at age 34
en.summary: American actor RJ Mitte, known for his role in Breaking Bad, has died at 34. The cause of death has not been disclosed.

stories.title: Smulders, Ostermann en Yentl en de Boer winnen cabaretprijs Poelifinario

en.title: Smulders, Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer win Poelifinario cabaret prize
en.summary: Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann, and the duo Yentl en de Boer won the Poelifinario, the Netherlands' leading cabaret award. David Linszen received the Neerlands Hoop prize for promising theatre makers.

stories.title: Groot cyberincident bij Albert Heijn: 'Je neemt niet zomaar zulke maatregelen'

en.title: Major cyber incident at Albert Heijn: 'You don't just take such measures'
en.summary: Cybersecurity experts consider it likely that Albert Heijn's systems have been breached. The supermarket chain has taken its online systems offline since Sunday as a precaution, causing significant in-store disruptions.

stories.title: Cabaretprijzen voor Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann en Yentl en de Boer

en.title: Cabaret prizes for Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer
en.summary: The VSCD Cabaret Prizes were awarded to Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann, Yentl en de Boer, and David Linszen for outstanding cabaret performances of the year.

stories.title: Cabaretiers Lisa Ostermann en Yentl en de Boer winnen hun tweede Poelifinario op rij

en.title: Cabarettists Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer win their second Poelifinario in a row
en.summary: Cabaret performers Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer have won their second consecutive Poelifinario award.

stories.title: Andere (online) supermarkten hebben het drukker door problemen bij Albert Heijn

en.title: Other (online) supermarkets are busier due to problems at Albert Heijn
en.summary: Competing supermarket chains are experiencing increased demand as Albert Heijn faces operational issues. Jumbo reports rising online orders and is scaling up capacity to handle potential customer shifts.

stories.title: Betekent het offline halen van meerdere systemen dat Albert Heijn niet weet waar de vermoedelijke hacker zit?

en.title: Does taking multiple systems offline mean Albert Heijn doesn't know where the suspected hacker is?
en.summary: Following a cyber incident, Albert Heijn has preventively shut down multiple IT systems and halted operations at some distribution centers, potentially causing empty shelves.
